meta.title: Implement Gemini client pool
meta.body_summary: Add multi-client Gemini support with GeminiClientPool for round-robin load balancing, attach client_id to conversations, and update health/chat endpoints to use the pool.

perf_labels.notes: Codex implemented multi-client pool with round-robin; Copilot bot flagged several correctness/d design issues, partially addressed before merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 433 changed lines across 13 files, this is a small-to-medium feature addition by absolute volume. It introduces a client pool, configuration changes, and service integration. The author self-merged after receiving only bot review comments, which is consistent with a low-risk, non-controversial change.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot inline comments flagged: (1) missing 'verbose' attribute in config schema, (2) inefficient pool instantiation per health check, (3) exception handling in LMDB find that could prematurely stop searching other clients. A low-confidence suppressed comment also warned about a missing 'os' import.
review_details.performance_claim: Enable round-robin load balancing across multiple Gemini client instances to improve throughput and session reuse.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Codex successfully added a client pool, but the implementation missed some concurrency and correctness details (race condition risk, missing attribute, import) that a human review or more thorough agent QA could catch. The bot identified these but they were only partially addressed before merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot performed static analysis and flagged missing configuration attribute, potential race condition in pool acquisition, and exception handling issues.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler data, or reproducible performance evaluation; only a narrative description of load balancing.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After bot review, the author added more logging and changed exception handling in LMDB find to continue instead of returning immediately. The missing attribute and race condition were not addressed.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced single Gemini client with GeminiClientPool using round-robin deque. Updated configuration to support list of client credentials. Integrated client_id into conversation hashing and storage. Wired health and chat endpoints to use the pool.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation, configuration wiring, and minor logging changes.
change_trajectory: Initial implementation with GeminiClientPool, config updates, and service integration.
Fixed environment variable overrides for multi-client config.
Fixed config reading and pool singleton usage.
Adopted bot suggestion to log and continue in LMDB find exception, added more logs.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot posted PR Overview summarizing multi-client pool changes; no blocking comments in the review body.
The 'verbose' property is not defined in the Gemini config schema; suggested adding a default fallback.
review_signals.action_taken: Not addressed in the PR commits.

review_signals.summary: Instantiating a new GeminiClientPool for every health check is inefficient; consider reusing a shared pool instance.
review_signals.action_taken: Not explicitly addressed, but the pool is available as a global singleton elsewhere.

review_signals.summary: In LMDB find, catching all exceptions and returning None stops search for other clients; suggested logging and continuing.
review_signals.action_taken: Author added more logs and changed exception handling to continue in commit f6eff015.

collaboration_trajectory: Codex agent opened PR with initial multi-client pool implementation and documentation updates.
Copilot bot provided two review rounds with inline comments on missing attribute, pool reuse, and exception handling.
Author iterated with commits to fix config reading, env overrides, and adjust LMDB exception logging per bot suggestion.
PR was self-merged by the author after ~26.6 hours with no human maintainer intervention.
